D/ IMP CARAVSIVS P F AVG

A coper alloy Roman radiate of Carausius dating to the period AD 286-293 (Reece period 14). Obverse legend reads IMP CARAVSIVS P F AVG; radiate, draped and cuirassed right. Reverse is unclear, but probably HIL[ARITAS AVG], showing Pax with branch and vertical sceptre. Mint unclear, but cf RIC V, pt 2, p. 530, nos. 803-5 for type.
